negative_control_note: Conventional-angle diagnostics are reported separately from the primary family to expose generic angular or mapping effects.
primary_outcome: building-level target/control difference in precomputed footprint signal rates
holdout_rule: sha256(seed:osm_id) < holdout_fraction; split is assigned before reading outcome summaries

matching.strict_sensitivity: controls used at most once; hard strata are observed settlement and mapping-density bins, plus county only when an external boundary layer is supplied

interpretation: All outputs are observational diagnostics. A significant association is not evidence of intentional design or causality.
